name: Animata
summary: 156+ animated React components — text effects, backgrounds, cards, buttons, widgets — to copy or install with the shadcn CLI.
description: Animata is a library of animated React components built with Tailwind CSS v4, organised into 19 categories (text, background, card, button, list, tabs, charts, progress, widgets and more). Every component ships with a live preview, source code and install instructions; add it through the shadcn CLI registry or copy-paste it into your project.
contains: 156+ animated React components filed in 19 categories
largest categories: text (42), widget (30), button (13), card (11), background (10)
live preview, source code and install instructions per component
install via the shadcn CLI registry or copy-paste
MIT licensed, theme-aware, built with Tailwind CSS v4
